name: Katie Inns
biography: Katie Inns is a Security Consultant in the Attack Surface Management (ASM) team at WithSecure. Katie has 6 years’ experience in the security industry, working in consulting and within an in-house security team focusing on vulnerability management and application security. Katie has spoken about the topic of ASM at conferences such as BlueTeam Con and conINT and holds the OSCP certification. Dancing has been Katie's hobby for 25 years and she also loves to listen to and play music. (4 underscores)
